title: Landslide Warnings and Safety
content: Stay alert and awake if you live in a landslide-prone area during severe storms. Listen for unusual sounds that might indicate moving debris, such as trees cracking or boulders knocking together. If you are near a stream or channel, be alert for any sudden increase or decrease in water flow and for a change from clear to muddy water. Move quickly away from the path of a landslide or debris flow. If escape is not possible, curl into a tight ball and protect your head.
